title: AAA RealityPlan — Ephemeral Controller State
description: Structured intermediate representation produced by the Consequence Compiler. Lives in controller memory; persists only when consequence demands it. Encoding: file != plan, plan != action, action != consequence, tool_return != observed_success, receipt != reality. Status: F13_RATIFIED_SOVEREIGN (2026-10-06 · sovereign quote

intent.description: Verbatim user / agent intent — what must exist after this turn.

evidence_ref.description: Pointer to a prior observation; not the observation itself.

intended_delta.description: From-state to to-state, not a file name or a tool list.

desired_state.description: AAOS v2.0 Level 2: flat desired-state spec alongside current_state. Optional; intended_delta may be used instead. 2026-10-06.

output_kind.description: What the compiler selects from. 'chat' = no persistent output. 'artifact' = persistent representation. 'action' = transition that changes state. 'workflow' = ordered transitions. 'mixed' = bundle for multiple consumers (Level 5 Bundle Law). 'none' = internal work. AAOS v2.0 2026-10-06.

persistence.description: Default ephemeral. PERSIST only when at least one reason is present.

transition.description: Only present when output_kind includes 'action' or 'workflow'.

capability.description: Existing capability ref, not a new tool.

authority_requirement.description: Authority attaches to the transition, not the plan. Required iff consequence crosses constitution-class authority AND no authorized alternative exists.

verification.description: Nested form (preferred). AAOS v2.0 Level 2 also accepts flat verification_before/verification_after.

verification_before.description: AAOS v2.0 Level 2: flat alias of verification.before. Optional.

verification_after.description: AAOS v2.0 Level 2: flat alias of verification.after. Optional.

observation.description: Consequence-specific sensor. arifFLOW is NOT universal reality witness.

task_status.description: USER-FACING status. Internal kernel state stays internal.

governance_state.description: INTERNAL ONLY. arifOS internals may use HOLD / SABAR / VOID / SEAL — these are NOT task_status values and never reach the human as interaction choices.

minimal_provenance.description: What we retain when the plan itself is discarded.

allOf.description: If output_kind is chat only, plan must not require persistence or authority.
